title: Juicy Malty Norwegian French Lentils Bake
description: A hearty, post-workout Norwegian dish featuring French lentils, baked to perfection in a copper pot, with a malty flavor and juicy texture, following Ayurvedic Rajasic-friendly principles.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a copper pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the French lentils, malt extract, vegetable broth, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 40 minutes, or until the lentils are tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the lentils hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
